replies.explain_cannot_approve: Arc cannot approve. Tick the box and press Approve job card.
replies.reply_out_of_scope: That is not something Arc does. Arc works on lots, conditions, settings, defects, job cards and plant data.

ask_clarification.request: Tell me what you want Arc to do. For example: read a sample order, check the weather or list the approved photos.
ask_clarification.sample_order: Which sample order should Arc read? Choose PO1 to PO5.
ask_clarification.photo: Which approved photo should Arc check? List the approved photos first.
ask_clarification.job: Which job card do you mean? Name a job from this session.
ask_clarification.lot: Which lot do you mean? Read an order to start a lot first.
ask_clarification.metric: Which figure do you want? Ask about a model score, a defect or a plant reading.

suggestions.get_status: How far can I trust the five models?
